messages.subject: logistic regression
parts:
I have run a logistic regression in Rattle and can't understand the
output. instead of having one single estimated coefficient, like one
should expect, Rattle gives multiple estimates per variable in the
form: var1.1, var1.2, var1.3, ..., var2.1, var2.2, var2.3, ...var3.1,
var3.2, var3.3 ...etc. how can I get Rattle to produce the correct
estimates? one more thing: if I want to check the correlation between
the variables, it returns an error. is it a bug?

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: logistic regression
parts:
Do have a look at the Log tab - it contains the actual R code that runs underneath and you can run that directly (copy and paste) in the R console to determine where the problem might be. Rattle is simply constructing the R commands to run.

You would also need to provide more information to debug this. My first guess without seeing anything to go on really is that the variables are categoric and not numeric? If that is the case, then what you see is correct, I think. categorics usually need to be turned into indicator variables for regression.

Regards,
Graham
